audience: Technical practitioners learning the reference explanation
scope: One image-first design pilot, not another whole-video motion render
generation_authorization: User explicitly requested generated graphic images and multiple storyboard images before motion.

scenes.transcript: Generic models are really good at searching the web or a a code base, anything that's got a really constrained space.
scenes.intended_understanding: In the source's constrained web-search example, retrieved information feeds a generic model and leads to a useful result.
scenes.template_variant: Constrained-context baseline before the business-context counterexample
scenes.composition: White faint grid; three fixed left-to-right card slots; warm peach model focal point; centered filled symbols and serif labels; independent reserved presenter tile.
scenes.assets: Generated master still and two image edits, source reference and rejected baseline. Editable layers are specified but not yet implemented.
scenes.reason: A left-to-right input, mechanism and outcome flow makes the relationship explicit. It is not a business-data architecture or a hierarchy.
scenes.alternative_and_tradeoff: A screenshot of search results. A screenshot could prove a specific result, but would obscure the conceptual input-to-model-to-output relationship being introduced here.
scenes.state_plan: Input → input and model → completed flow. Earlier states derived from the selected candidate master. Actual motion alignment is pending.
scenes.clarity_check: Review source versus candidate for typography, icon mass, card scale, shadow, spacing and continuity. Model-card relative scale remains a refinement; no visual approval asserted.

state_images.narration_role: Introduce the web-search input as it is named.
state_images.new_understanding: Identify the input source before showing its route.
state_images.next_transition: Reveal first connector, then the model surface, icon and label.

state_images.narration_role: Show the generic model using the constrained search input.
state_images.new_understanding: Make the input-to-model relationship visible; the model is the focal object.
state_images.next_transition: Reveal second connector and result components, then hold the complete flow.

state_images.narration_role: Complete the source's constrained-context example before contrasting business questions.
state_images.new_understanding: See the complete input, mechanism and outcome relationship.
state_images.next_transition: Reading hold, then the separately storyboarded business-context counterexample.
persistent: all components until the next conceptual change

layer_reconstruction.still_check: Compare the editable settled still to the chosen generated master and source before adding motion.
layer_reconstruction.raster_rule: The generated storyboard is an art-direction target, not the flattened animation substrate. Keep exact text, geometry, connectors and motion editable.
